Name: Mosaic mirror art
Description:
Add a bold, avant-garde statement to your space with our Reflective Stallion. This isn’t just wall art; it’s a conversation piece. Each piece is meticulously hand-assembled using shattered mirror fragments to form the powerful silhouette of a horse against a deep, textured midnight-black canvas.

Because of the mosaic technique, the artwork "changes" throughout the day. As the sun moves or your room lights dim, the mirror shards catch the light from different angles, bringing a sense of life and motion to the stallion

 

Safety Disclaimer: Since this is "broken DIY mirror" art, be sure to include a small note that the edges are sealed (if they are) or that it is intended for decorative display out of reach of children.
